title: Basic cover
text: Basic cover. Meh. This is definitely not the best sofa cover. It's a basic cover that does the job adequately. It slides in place and uses those stupid push down stick thingys beneath the cushions. What that means is every time people or the dogs bounce onto the couch, the sticks slide up a bit until they come out entirely.  Our regular sofa covers use big elastic straps and can tie so they almost never slide. The color is nice and it does cover our sofa, but there are better choices for dog homes.
